scripts.build: prisma contract emit && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-pdf-assets.mjs
scripts.predev: pnpm --filter @puffinpal/permissions build && pnpm --filter database build && prisma contract emit && node scripts/copy-pdf-assets.mjs
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: prisma contract emit && prisma migration plan && prisma db migrate --advance-ref db
scripts.prisma:sync: prisma contract emit && prisma db update
scripts.prisma:plan: prisma contract emit && prisma migration plan
scripts.database:seed: pnpm --filter database build && pnpm run build && node dist/src/database/seed.js
scripts.test: node --test test/password.test.mjs test/permissions.test.mjs test/account-settings.test.mjs test/session.test.mjs test/invoice-calculations.test.mjs test/organization-logo.test.mjs test/invoice-pdf.test.mjs test/onboarding.test.mjs test/profile-picture.test.mjs test/invoice-payments.test.mjs test/expenses.test.mjs
scripts.test:expenses: pnpm run build && node --test test/expenses.test.mjs && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs test/expenses.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:invoices: pnpm --filter @puffinpal/permissions build && pnpm --filter database build && pnpm run build && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs test/invoices.e2e.test.mjs test/invoice-drafts.e2e.test.mjs test/invoice-issuance.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @puffinpal/permissions build && pnpm --filter database build && pnpm run build && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:invoice-pdf: pnpm --filter @puffinpal/permissions build && pnpm --filter database build && pnpm run build && node --test test/invoice-pdf.test.mjs test/invoice-pdf-storage.test.mjs && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs test/invoice-pdf.e2e.test.mjs test/invoice-issuance.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:onboarding: pnpm run build && node --test test/onboarding.test.mjs && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs test/onboarding.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:payments: pnpm --filter @puffinpal/permissions build && pnpm --filter database build && pnpm run build && node --test test/invoice-payments.test.mjs && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs test/invoice-payments.e2e.test.mjs
scripts.test:redis: pnpm run build && node --test test/redis-throttler.test.mjs test/session.test.mjs
scripts.test:invoice-exports: pnpm run build && node --test test/invoice-export.test.mjs && node scripts/test-auth-e2e.mjs test/invoice-exports.e2e.test.mjs
